learning_outcomes.text: You know the management tools of modern production management.
You know the principles of the continuous improvement process (CIP).
You master basic methods for reducing waste.

syllabus_topics: Quality management in production (including manufacturing metrology)
Process optimization, CIP tools, setup optimization
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the examination performance must be passed and the participation in exercises/laboratory experiments (unassessed academic achievement) must be successful. The overall grade weighting is determined by credit points.
